info.name: Client Accounts Client Account Management Endpoints API
info.description:
The Client Accounts API allows you to create, manage and retrieve information about client accounts.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: help@vopay.com

query.description: (Required) Client account ID of customer who's balance you want to retrieve
3 character currency code for the currency to fetch transactions for. If this is not specified it will be defaulted to the account's local currency (generally CAD).

urlencoded.description: (Required) Your account ID
(Required) API key for the account
(Required) Hashed signature for the request
(Required) Client account ID of customer who's info you would like to update
Client's first name
Client's last name
Client's email address - Must be a valid email
Business name.
Company registration number. A 9-digit number that is unique to a business or legal entity.
ID that represents the company's industry classification. See /account/business-types endpoint for more information.
ID that indicates the company's category classification. See /account/business-types endpoint for more information.
Company's website URL. It must be a valid URL and the protocol must be included (http or https).
Company's phone number. Digits only - no parentheses or dashes allowed.
Client's address line 1
Client's city
Client's province specified using two character abbreviations (eg. BC, AB)
Client's country specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (eg. CA, US).
Client's nationality specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.
Client's postal code.
Client's ID (driver's licence or federal tax ID).
This option will add a Label to the client account. If the Label doesn't exist it will be created and applied.
This option will update the client's default method used for Interac e-Transfers (eg. email, phone). Only applicable for Canadian VoPay Accounts.

request.description:
This endpoint returns a list of the available client accounts and some of its details.

It is also possible to filter the list of client accounts by ClientAccountID, its status (active or inactive), and client type (business, individual, receive-only).
